data.about_content:
IGNOU Online University (Indira Gandhi National Open University) offers a highly flexible and affordable Online MBA (Master of Business Administration) program. IGNOU Online MBA is a 2-year professional postgraduate program aimed at individuals and working professionals seeking flexibility in their academic journey. IGNOU Online MBA predominantly caters to working professionals who are willing to enhance their managerial skills without interrupting their careers. IGNOU Online University has structured this Online MBA program in consultation with industry experts to ensure relevance and applicability to current business practices.

IGNOU Online MBA offers a comprehensive understanding of management principles and practices, focusing on theoretical knowledge and practical skills. IGNOU Online MBA curriculum covers a wide range of business disciplines that play an essential role in effective business management.

IGNOU Online University employs a robust Learning Management System (LMS) that includes multimedia content, interactive sessions, and virtual classrooms to impart learning for its Online MBA program.

IGNOU Online MBA allows working professionals and individuals to study at their own pace and convenience with flexibility in their learning schedules.

This program has a competitive and affordable fee structure that makes quality education accessible to a diverse range of students and working professionals. IGNOU Online MBA program combines flexibility, quality education, and affordability to offer advanced knowledge and expertise in business management.

highlights.highlight_title: IGNOU Online MBA has a contemporary curriculum and the latest study material.
IGNOU Online University offers 116 credit points for an Online MBA that will be deposited in the student’s ABC (Academic Bank of Credit) account.
IGNOU Online University provides synchronous mentoring and assessment with the help of its specified Regional Centres.
Asynchronous counseling/mentoring is provided in IGNOU Online MBA in OER/Video format.
IGNOU Online University evaluates students based on assignments (30% weightage ) and end-term exams (70% weightage ).
A robust mechanism for the redressal of student grievances is also provided in IGNOU Online MBA.

data.eligibility_content:
Candidates willing to enroll in the Online MBA program at IGNOU Online University must meet the following eligibility requirements-

  • Passed a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • Scored at least 50% marks in graduation(45% for the reserved category).
  • No age bar.
data.admission_steps:
Working professional and fresh graduates who are willing to pursue the IGNOU Online MBA program are required to follow the step-by-step admission process of the program listed below:

Step 1. Visit the official IGNOU website and register yourself.

Step 2. Click on Apply Now tab and start filling out your IGNOU online MBA application process.

Step 3. Fill in the required details and attach the supporting documents along with the application form.

Step 4. Pay the program fee and submit the application form.

Step 5. Print out the application form for future reference and wait for admission confirmation from the university.
data.syllabus_content:
The curriculum of IGNOU Online MBA is designed in a balanced form that offers students both theoretical understanding and practical skills necessary for a successful business career. The program offers 5 industry-relevant specializations. The syllabus of this program is the latest and meets the industry demands. The program spans 2 years with 4 semesters. The syllabus of IGNOU Online MBA is the same for all students till the 2nd semester, and they can choose the specialization in the 3rd and 4th semesters. The specialization chosen in the 3rd semester will also be applicable in the 4th semester. A full breakdown of the IGNOU Online MBA syllabus is listed below:
